svg.title: The corrected shared cache
svg.desc: Make erased peer-to-peer lines faint, interrupted remnants and the retained cache routes firm. The source card and model response must visibly motivate the correction from human drawing to evidence-based topology.

The source card and model response must visibly motivate the correction from human drawing to evidence-based topology.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.05, 0.77, 0.9, 0.2 ] } ], "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-curt-home-office", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.07, 0.139, 0.1, 0.076 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "RUN" }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.07, 0.31000000000000005, 0.1, 0.076 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.07, 0.481, 0.1, 0.076 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true }, { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.2, 0.15800000000000003, 0.12, 0.03325 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.2, 0.32899999999999996, 0.12, 0.03325 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.2, 0.5, 0.12, 0.03325 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.34, 0.12, 0.2, 0.45599999999999996 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SHARED CACHE" }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.67, 0.55, 0.25, 0.14 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SOURCE" } ], "reconstructed": true, "shot": "diagram", "source": "
**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Curt inks connecting lines across the sketch from panel 2 — a web, every agent lane joined to every other. ChatGPT's block returns beside it with the source passage open, one sentence held up against the drawing.

**Screen / system text — CHATGPT:**
> The record has no line between two runs. Each one writes into the cache and reads what is already there. Draw the web and you have drawn a network nobody found.

**Action:** Curt erases every connecting line. The lanes end up touching the directory tree and nothing else — the geometry pages [001](001.md)–[005](005.md) already use.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> That's the first thing I had wrong. And I'd have drawn it a hundred more times.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `documented` — the exchange is invented; the distinction it turns on is documented. `METR` describes isolated workloads communicating through shared writable state, with no direct channel between any two runs, which is why no page in this book joins a pair. The correction runs from the model to the human.

", "title": "The corrected shared cache" } }
